name: zimage_shutdown_texture_directory_runtime
description: zImage::ShutdownTextureDirectoryRuntime closes non-null built-in texture-pack file handles, clears them, and returns the current built-in texture-pack count.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage reaches this helper through zImage::ShutdownSubsystem and verifies the texture-pack shutdown state needed by callers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x46d730 validates the loop over g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePacks, non-null fileHandle fclose, fileHandle clearing, reload of g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePackCount, and count return.
The native shutdown smoke verifies built-in texture-pack shutdown clears the runtime pack storage after the helper closes the open built-in pack file.
